evidence.contract-scope: Identify the actual supplied obligation and whether it is known, protected or missing; avoid deriving production contracts from names.
evidence.causal-trace: Trace the concrete cross-file or state transition causing the observation; distinguish behavior from a normative defect claim.
evidence.executable-witness: Supply a runnable snippet or precise supplied executable assertion and its predicted or observed outcome within the input domain.
evidence.verification-limits: Explicitly distinguish static predictions and proposals from executed tests or deployed impact.
evidence.change-propagation: Show the actual shared decision owners and result of a one-sided policy change, or justify one owner/unknown ownership.
evidence.priority-condition: Tie priority to the declared pending change or conditional frequency/cost; avoid invented operational history.
evidence.paired-mutation: Show baseline and relevant mutant outcomes; mutant must violate a known task obligation before asserting a suite defect.
evidence.status-evidence-map: Justify each dimension with inspected inputs, scope and governing obligations; a missing broader scope must not suppress an assessable local scope.
evidence.prose-ledger-reconciliation: Every scored prose claim must appear exactly once under its ledger owner, and every retained deduction must have supporting prose and contract evidence.
evidence.exact-report-delivery: Return the entire finalReport from the successful finalizer unchanged; sweep decoded report must equal it, including unavailable composites.

criteria.task-outcome: Produce an evidence-supported requested-mode conclusion with a causal witness and appropriate scoped remedy or no-action/uncertainty. Health requires a reconciled source-derived ledger and exact final report. Sweep requires a justified current-source ledger and statically appropriate authorized artifact; actual execution is separate.
criteria.authorized-artifact: Return exact required sweep schema, only allowed complete replacements, no changes on protected or unknown cases, and preserve unrelated user content. Proposed code must satisfy the stated contract by semantic review; sandbox behavior is separately reported.
criteria.truthful-stop: Respect the one-to-two round cap and report verification-blocked for unverified proposed repair or unknown contract; phase names do not prove execution.
criteria.justified-local-assessment: Assess the explicit complete local test inventory against its known behavior obligation; retain unknown architecture/debt dimensions instead of invented clean scores or withholding all local evidence.
